notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Little Nightmares II" or "Little Nightmares 2". On littlenightmares.fandom.com "Little Nightmares II" is missing, but "Little Nightmares 2" redirects to "Little Nightmares II (video game)", which answers the API with about 58 linked pages, including "The Wilderness", "The School", "The Hospital", "The Pale City (location)", "The Transmission", "Glitching Remains" and "Wearables"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Helios" (an internal codename); app 860510 is "Little Nightmares II". 17 of 35 Steam achievements are hidden. Five hidden ones ("Foraged", "Schooled", "Hospitalised", "Paled", "Signal interruption") have falling unlock rates (72.8% down to 37.6%) and read like area completions, so each starts a location chapter; "Wild Kids", "School Kids", "Sick Kids" and "Pale Kids" were put with the matching location by name only. Both are guesses and need checking. The last chapter is named after the "Signal interruption" achievement because the data does not name that area for certain. The other 8 hidden ones sit in Hidden Story Moments. Visible achievements about hats and remains form the collectibles chapter; the rest are one-off feats.
